stem: A promotion on Voltmarkt's 55-inch TV has a cannibalisation rate of 40%. What does this number mean?

options.text: The other TVs sold 40% fewer units than in their baseline weeks
The TV category as a whole sold 40% more units than its baseline
Other TVs lost 4 units for every 10 extra units the 55-inch sold
40% of the 55-inch TV's promotion units went to new customers
